wall_check.method: Seeded area sampling of original outer surface; local facet normals; exclude end rims, z<5, 2.4 mm around slot boundaries, vent boundaries and side-button transitions. These edge chords are not normal wall measurements. Not a continuous global minimum-wall proof.

local_feature_dimensions.note: Curve rims and hole mouths require deburring. Sampling does not certify a continuous global minimum.
